meta.title: The AI Safety field, by the numbers

people.label: People (FTEs)
people.note: Full-time-equivalent researchers. Hand-curated yearly snapshots from the field-growth analyses below; the field is small (~1,100 FTEs in 2025) and per-bucket splits are approximate, so totals don't sum exactly. Buckets marked 'estimated' are back-of-envelope.

papers.label: Papers / year
papers.note: A research-VOLUME proxy: arXiv papers per year matching each branch's search terms. Auto-refreshed monthly by scripts/fetch-field-map.mjs. Noisy and over-counts where terms are broad — read it as relative effort, not a headcount.

sources.label: Estimating the Number of AI Safety Researchers
Emerging Technology Observatory – AI safety almanac

buckets.label: Mechanistic interpretability
buckets.blurb: Reverse-engineering model internals: circuits, features, sparse autoencoders.
buckets.arxiv: ("mechanistic interpretability" OR "sparse autoencoder" OR "superposition") AND (neural OR transformer OR language model)

buckets.label: Scalable oversight
buckets.blurb: RLHF, RLAIF, debate, recursive reward modeling, weak-to-strong generalization.
buckets.arxiv: ("scalable oversight" OR RLHF OR "reinforcement learning from human feedback" OR "weak-to-strong" OR "AI debate")

buckets.label: Robustness & jailbreaks
buckets.blurb: Adversarial robustness, jailbreak resistance, distribution shift.
buckets.arxiv: (jailbreak OR "adversarial robustness" OR "adversarial examples") AND ("language model" OR LLM OR neural)

buckets.label: LLM safety
buckets.blurb: Safety work focused specifically on large language models.
buckets.arxiv: ("LLM safety" OR "language model safety" OR "safe language model" OR "harmlessness")

buckets.label: Evals & dangerous-capability testing
buckets.blurb: Capability and propensity evals — bio, cyber, autonomy, persuasion (AISI, METR, Apollo).
buckets.arxiv: ("dangerous capabilities" OR "capability evaluation" OR "model evaluation" OR "red teaming") AND ("language model" OR LLM OR "frontier model")

buckets.label: Deceptive alignment & scheming
buckets.blurb: Sleeper agents, mesa-optimization, scheming, models hiding their objectives.
buckets.arxiv: ("deceptive alignment" OR "sleeper agent" OR scheming OR "mesa-optimization" OR "mesa optimizer")

buckets.label: RL & reward hacking
buckets.blurb: Reward hacking, specification gaming, goal misgeneralization.
buckets.arxiv: ("reward hacking" OR "specification gaming" OR "goal misgeneralization" OR "reward misspecification")

buckets.label: Agent foundations
buckets.blurb: Decision theory, embedded agency, corrigibility (MIRI-lineage theory).
buckets.arxiv: ("agent foundations" OR corrigibility OR "embedded agency" OR "decision theory") AND (AI OR agent)

buckets.label: AI control
buckets.blurb: Containing misaligned-but-capable models — distinct from aligning them.
buckets.arxiv: ("AI control" OR "controlling untrusted" OR "control evaluations") AND (AI OR "language model" OR model)

buckets.label: AI security
buckets.blurb: Model-weight security, data poisoning, misuse and uplift pathways.
buckets.arxiv: ("model weight" OR "data poisoning" OR "backdoor attack" OR "model extraction") AND (neural OR "language model")

buckets.label: Forecasting & timelines
buckets.blurb: Scaling laws, takeoff dynamics, timeline forecasting (incl. Epoch AI).
buckets.arxiv: ("scaling laws" OR "compute trends" OR "AI timelines" OR "emergent abilities")

buckets.label: Learning theory & guarantees
buckets.blurb: Formal guarantees, singular learning theory, theoretical safety.
buckets.arxiv: ("singular learning theory" OR "provable safety" OR "formal verification") AND (neural OR "deep learning")

buckets.label: Compute governance
buckets.blurb: Tracking/controlling training compute, export controls, on-chip mechanisms.
buckets.arxiv: ("compute governance" OR "hardware governance" OR "on-chip" OR "export controls") AND (AI OR chip OR semiconductor)

buckets.label: Policy & standards
buckets.blurb: Frontier-model regulation, evals-based policy, standards, law (EU AI Act, RSPs).
buckets.arxiv: ("AI regulation" OR "AI policy" OR "AI governance" OR "frontier AI") AND (policy OR regulation OR standard)

buckets.label: International coordination
buckets.blurb: Treaties, arms-race dynamics, international institutions for AI.
buckets.arxiv: ("international governance" OR "AI treaty" OR "arms race" OR "international coordination") AND AI

buckets.label: Lab governance & RSPs
buckets.blurb: Responsible scaling policies, internal lab governance and commitments.
buckets.arxiv: ("responsible scaling" OR "responsible AI" OR "AI safety levels" OR "corporate governance") AND AI

buckets.label: Advocacy & field-building
buckets.blurb: Public engagement, awareness, talent pipelines and field-building.
buckets.arxiv: ("public attitudes" OR "AI awareness" OR "field building") AND (AI OR "artificial intelligence")

buckets.label: Ethics & societal impact
buckets.blurb: Fairness, bias, model welfare, and broader social impact of advanced AI.
buckets.arxiv: ("AI ethics" OR "AI fairness" OR "algorithmic bias" OR "model welfare")
